Coram : G.S. SINGHVI*, S. J. MUKHOPADHAYA
A B Service Law· - Appointment on deputation - Post of Director, A/GTE - Offer of appointment to appellant - C Withdrawal of, on the ground that appellant was receiving higher pay scale in his parent department and deputation from higher post to lower post is not admissible - Challenged - affirming the order of cancellation of offer of appointment failed to appreciate the difference between "appointment on deputation" and "transfer on deputation" - The case of appellant is not a case of transfer on deputation - It is a case of appointment on deputation
Decision Date : 16-07-2012 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5225/2012 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
